alt: Card: under Ministerial Decision No. 84 of 2025, a UAE taxable person that is not a Tax Group, with revenue above AED 50m in a tax period, prepares audited financial statements. For a 31 December year-end, the audit tests balances from the December close, so reconcile bank, intercompany and control accounts, fix the 31 December cut-off and back every accrual with a schedule.

captions.linkedin:
If your year ends on 31 December, your auditor will test those balances, and every one of them comes out of the December close.

Under Ministerial Decision No. 84 of 2025, Art. 2, a Taxable Person that is not a Tax Group and earns revenue above AED 50m in a tax period must prepare and maintain audited financial statements, for tax periods starting on or after 1 January 2025 (UAE Ministry of Finance).

What should the December close include? In our view, start with:
• Bank, intercompany and control accounts reconciled
• Sales and purchases cut off at 31 December, and the stock count date agreed with the auditor
• A schedule behind every accrual and provision
